H4: Passive income target of $40k/mo ($480k/yr) is achievable at 5-6% yield with ~$8-10M HKD principal — but HK dividend stocks/REITs offer 5-7% yields (Link REIT 6.52%, China Mobile 6.44%, VTech 7.88%), so the required principal is lower than the earlier 4-5% estimate (~$9.6-12M). keyInsights: Mainland marriage registration is a FREE asset-protection mechanism (no prenup needed) — pre-marital assets stay individual under 婚姻法第18条. This is a major strategic advantage vs HK registration.

港車北上 (NOT 中港牌) is the real "cross-border driving" goal — individual, cheap (~$2-3k/yr), no tax threshold. This DOWNGRADES the driver cost: a regular driver + 港車北上 covers the Zhongshan commute, no premium 中港牌 driver needed.
Passive income to match GF's $40k requires ~$8-9.6M HKD principal at 5-6% yield (HK dividend stocks/REITs deliver 5-7%). This is the real "financial freedom" number, not the salary.
Zhongshan avg price 8,428元/㎡ means 670k RMB loan ≈ 80㎡ unit (or smaller in premium 东区). Property is affordable relative to HK.
Bodyguard is a SELLER'S MARKET in HK right now (post-abduction demand surge) — salaried roles list at $40-60k/mo, freelance 高級保鏢 day-rates $4-8k. The $40k "stepping-stone" is actually a FLOOR.

Zeekr 009 (7-seat luxury EV MPV) is the "driver + family + 接待" answer, BUT at $832k-927k it is 3.1x the 7X base ($269,900) — a major budget decision, not a trivial upgrade. The 7X fire incident is now DOWNGRADED (collision-damaged vehicle, not a defect).

Zeekr 7X HK ownership has real friction: 錦龍 sole-dealer service is poor, HK spec is stripped vs mainland, and battery warranty is 8yr (vs lifetime mainland / BYD lifetime in HK). For a cross-border 港車北上 use case, buying the mainland-spec 7X (or a BYD with lifetime battery) may be smarter than the HK-spec 7X.
銀色債券 2026 (4.25% guaranteed, 3yr, up to $1M) is a risk-free floor that beats current time deposits (2.2-2.4%) — a concrete near-term parking option while building the dividend portfolio.
